question: What are your business hours?
answer: We are open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. Our customer support team is available during these hours via phone, email, and live chat.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. To initiate a return, log into your account, go to Order History, and select the item you wish to return. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Expedited shipping takes 2-3 business days. Overnight shipping is available for an additional fee. All orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are encrypted and processed securely through our payment gateway.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. Enter your registered email address and we'll send you a password reset link. The link expires after 24 hours. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also log into your account and visit the Order History section to see real-time tracking updates.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 10-15 business days. Customs duties and import taxes may apply depending on your country and are the responsibility of the buyer.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel your order within 1 hour of placing it by going to Order History and clicking 'Cancel Order'. After 1 hour, orders enter processing and cannot be cancelled. In that case, you can return the item after delivery.

question: What is your warranty policy?
answer: All products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Extended warranties of up to 3 years are available for purchase at checkout. Warranty claims can be filed through our support portal.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach us by email at support@example.com, by phone at 1-800-555-0123, or through the live chat widget on our website. Our support team typically responds to emails within 4 hours during business hours.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: You can update your shipping address within 1 hour of placing your order by contacting customer support. Once the order has been shipped, the address cannot be changed. You may need to arrange a redirect through the carrier.

question: Do you offer gift cards?
answer: Yes, we offer digital gift cards in denominations of $25, $50, $100, and $200. Gift cards are delivered via email and never expire. They can be used for any product on our website.

question: What do I do if I receive a damaged item?
answer: If you receive a damaged item, please contact our support team within 48 hours with photos of the damage. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund. You do not need to return the damaged item.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of our website. Enter your name, email address, and create a password. You'll receive a verification email to confirm your account. You can also sign up using your Google or Facebook account.
